svg.title: Figure 5-3. SM-TOY-AUTH, animated (WP-W-05)
svg.desc: Animated walk through SM-TOY-AUTH: T1a from NOT_ALLOWED to ENGAGE_PENDING on 0x1D2 valid. T1b from ENGAGE_PENDING to ALLOWED on safety task (100 Hz). T10a from ALLOWED to NOT_ALLOWED on safety task: heartbeat check.
svg.text: Figure 5-3 · SM-TOY-AUTH, animated: engage, then lose the heartbeat
A walk through the record: NOT_ALLOWED → ENGAGE_PENDING → ALLOWED → NOT_ALLOWED, firing T1a, T1b, T10a; 4 s per step

g.text: After a safety mode is set, authority is not granted; the envelope waits for a cruise edge from the car.

[CRUISE_ACTIVE 0→1, rx_checks_allow_engagement(), CRUISE_ACTIVE = 0 received since the safety mode was set, heartbeat engaged = 0 at the edge, MAIN_ON = 1 (an edge while MAIN_ON = 0 opens the window and closes it …
/ open the 1 s window (pcm_engage_pending, pcm_engage_ts) · build reference · SWSR-301, SWSR-306, SWSR-311, SWSR-405, SWSR-518 · partly
T1b: ENGAGE_PENDING → ALLOWED on safety task (100 Hz)
[heartbeat engaged = 1 within 1 s of the edge, and rx_checks_allow_engagement()]
/ set, close the window · build reference · SWSR-301, SWSR-306, SWSR-405, SWSR-518 · partly
T10a: ALLOWED → NOT_ALLOWED on safety task: heartbeat check
[no SoC heartbeat for > 0.3 s in a car mode]
/ clear; siren 3 s when authority was granted (panda c33343b) · build all · SWSR-407, SWSR-516 · partly

svg.text: status as WP-W-05 §5 gives it, from the SWSRs each transition realises
Generated by fig_w05_uml_states.py from state-machines/sm-toy-auth.yaml; the walk (T1a, T1b, T10a) is chosen here and checked to chain from the initial state.

g.text: Terms: ALLOWED the envelope's authority state with controls_allowed = 1 (NOT_ALLOWED: 0), WP-W-05 §5.2 · SM-TOY SM-TOY-AUTH, the state machine of the Toyota authority controls_allowed (WP-W-05 §5.2) · SoC system on
